description: Unified search across all document sources (docs, wiki, and email). Returns results ranked by relevance. Search operators (site:, after:, before:, from:, link:, /regex/ ...) are applied per source; operators and warnings say what the query used, and skipped names each source the query left out and why. With define:<term> it also returns definition, the same card search_docs returns.

query.description: Search query (supports both keywords and natural language). Operators apply to every source they fit: after:/before:, site:docs|wiki|mail|commits, intitle:, from:, link:<url glob>, /regex/ (see GET /api/v2/links and the /search page's syntax help).

name: search_all_sources
